name: Rupees in words
author: friday-core
description: Writes an amount as ₹12,34,567.89 and as words (Rupees Twelve Lakh Thirty Four Thousand Five Hundred Sixty Seven and Paise Eighty Nine Only), as cheques and invoices need. Understands 1.5 crore, 2 lakh 50 thousand and plain numbers. Rounds to the nearest paisa.
